stops.name: Vanoise National Park
stops.detail: Vanoise National Park (French: Parc national de la Vanoise) is a French national park between the Tarentaise and Maurienne valleys in the French Alps, containing the Vanoise Massif. It was created in 1963 as the first national park in France.
